key.name: grid-items
key.description: Each entry is id:size:row:column (4 columns). Full-width sizes (full, compact, grid, row, normal, short) keep the classic look; the others are tiles (1x1, 2x1, 2x2, 4x2). Items not listed are not shown.

key.name: grid-gap
key.summary: Space between menu items, in pixels

key.name: hidden-titles
key.summary: Menu pieces shown without their title

key.name: panel-items
key.description: Ids: icon, cpu, gpu, mode, fan, power. The GPU temperature only shows while the GPU is awake; the power draw only on battery.

key.name: ac-profile
key.summary: Profile applied when the charger is plugged in (empty = keep the current one)

key.name: battery-profile
key.summary: Profile applied when running on battery (empty = keep the current one)

key.name: battery-60hz
key.summary: Lower the laptop screen to 60 Hz on battery
key.description: Only the built-in screen; the previous refresh rate comes back when plugged in.

key.name: modes-expanded
key.summary: Modes section expanded in the menu

key.name: peripherals-expanded
key.summary: Peripherals section expanded in the menu

key.name: turbo-key
key.summary: Use the NitroSense key to toggle the Performance profile
